# Ahrefs Changelog: Running List of New Features
### The pace we ship at
![tiktok social media tool](https://ahrefs.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/tiktok-social-media-tool.webp)

**29 Aug**: In Keywords Explorer’s Traffic Share reports, a new competitors map visualises who is winning your keywords by traffic and traffic value.

**22 Aug**: Brand Radar charts can now be exported directly – send data to Google Sheets or download any chart as CSV for easier sharing and analysis.

**22 Aug**: Cited Domains and Cited Pages in Brand Radar now have dedicated filters for domains and URLs, plus Cited Domains shows how many cited pages each domain has to highlight where coverage is concentrated.

**19 Aug**: Launched Ahrefs Connect – our new integration layer on API v3 – so third-party tools can access your Ahrefs data via OAuth (competitive intel, Site Audit, organic, backlinks, and more).

**19 Aug**: Site Explorer Overview now includes a SERP features history chart that shows how many positions you hold in SERP features over time (owned vs total), with interactive drilldowns into Organic Keywords.

**18 Aug**: Rank Tracker and GSC charts now use shared user notes across the whole workspace – everyone with access to the project can see them, and editors can update any note.

**15 Aug**: New Google AI Mode index in Brand Radar lets you track how your brand shows up in Google’s AI chat experience inside Search (US, UK, and India initially), bundled with AI Overviews and included in All Platforms.

**14 Aug**: Brand Radar now offers demo searches so all paid users can test-drive the tool with preloaded queries before setting up their own brands.

**8 Aug**: Add Brand Radar 2.0 Mentions charts for all platforms to your reports in Reports Builder, so you can pipe AI visibility straight into recurring client or stakeholder reports.

**8 Aug**: Rank Tracker now supports per-project keyword limits, helping teams keep projects tidy and control scale on large accounts.

**8 Aug**: Brand Radar 2.0 is live – the tool now mirrors Site Explorer with an Overview plus dedicated reports (AI Responses, Cited Domains, Cited Pages, Topics, and more), making it easier to explore how your brand shows up across AI answers and the web that feeds them.

**1 Aug**: Site Audit now shows AI detection signals directly in URL details, so you can inspect likely AI-written content alongside technical issues for each page.

**1 Aug**: Site Explorer’s Backlinks reports now include links from YouTube videos – useful if you build links via video or want to track brand mentions coming from YouTube.
